```{=html}
<style>
.reset-stage {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  min-height: 60vh; text-align: center; gap: 1.4rem; padding: 2rem 1rem;
}
.breath-circle {
  width: 240px; height: 240px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, rgba(255,199,44,.45), rgba(153,0,0,.85));
  box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(153,0,0,.18);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  color: #fff; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.4rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  transform: scale(.55);
  transition: transform 4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), box-shadow 4s ease;
  user-select: none;
}
.breath-circle.inhale { transform: scale(1); box-shadow: 0 0 80px rgba(153,0,0,.32); }
.breath-circle.hold { transform: scale(1); }
.breath-circle.exhale { transform: scale(.55); box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(153,0,0,.10); }
.breath-label { font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--bs-secondary-color); min-height: 1.4em; }
.breath-controls { display: flex; gap: .6rem; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; }
.breath-controls button {
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color); background: var(--bs-body-bg); color: var(--bs-body-color);
  padding: .55rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer;
}
.breath-controls button:hover, .breath-controls button.active {
  background: rgba(153,0,0,.08); border-color: rgba(153,0,0,.4); color: #990000;
}
.breath-cycles { font-size: .9rem; color: var(--bs-secondary-color); margin-top: .3rem; }
.next-step {
  margin-top: 1.5rem; padding: 1rem 1.2rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color); border-left: 4px solid #FFC72C;
  border-radius: 8px; max-width: 540px;
  font-size: .95rem; line-height: 1.5;
}
.next-step strong { color: #990000; }
</style>

<div class="reset-stage">
  <div id="breathCircle" class="breath-circle">Tap Start</div>
  <div id="breathLabel" class="breath-label">Box breathing · inhale 4 · hold 4 · exhale 4 · hold 4</div>
  <div class="breath-controls">
    <button id="breathStart">Start</button>
    <button id="breathStop">Stop</button>
    <button data-cycles="3" class="active">3 cycles · ~50s</button>
    <button data-cycles="5">5 cycles · ~80s</button>
    <button data-cycles="8">8 cycles · ~130s</button>
  </div>
  <div id="breathCycles" class="breath-cycles">Cycle 0 / 3</div>
  <div class="next-step">
    <strong>When this finishes,</strong> close this tab and open <a href="tonight.html">Tonight's Plan</a>. Do the first task. Don't re-plan; the plan is fine.
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
  const circle = document.getElementById("breathCircle");
  const label = document.getElementById("breathLabel");
  const counter = document.getElementById("breathCycles");
  const startBtn = document.getElementById("breathStart");
  const stopBtn = document.getElementById("breathStop");
  const cycleBtns = document.querySelectorAll("[data-cycles]");
  let totalCycles = 3;
  let cycle = 0;
  let phaseTimeout = null;
  const phases = [
    { name: "inhale", text: "Inhale", duration: 4000 },
    { name: "hold", text: "Hold", duration: 4000 },
    { name: "exhale", text: "Exhale", duration: 4000 },
    { name: "hold", text: "Hold", duration: 4000 }
  ];
  let phaseIdx = 0;

  function setCycles(n) {
    totalCycles = n;
    cycle = 0;
    counter.textContent = `Cycle 0 / ${n}`;
    cycleBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("active", Number(b.dataset.cycles) === n));
  }

  function stop() {
    if (phaseTimeout) clearTimeout(phaseTimeout);
    phaseTimeout = null;
    circle.className = "breath-circle";
    circle.textContent = cycle >= totalCycles ? "Done" : "Tap Start";
    label.textContent = cycle >= totalCycles ? "Reset complete. Back to work." : "Box breathing · inhale 4 · hold 4 · exhale 4 · hold 4";
  }

  function tick() {
    if (cycle >= totalCycles) { stop(); return; }
    const p = phases[phaseIdx];
    circle.className = "breath-circle " + p.name;
    circle.textContent = p.text;
    label.textContent = `${p.text} · ${Math.round(p.duration/1000)}s`;
    phaseTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      phaseIdx = (phaseIdx + 1) % phases.length;
      if (phaseIdx === 0) {
        cycle += 1;
        counter.textContent = `Cycle ${cycle} / ${totalCycles}`;
      }
      tick();
    }, p.duration);
  }

  function start() {
    if (phaseTimeout) return;
    cycle = 0; phaseIdx = 0;
    counter.textContent = `Cycle 0 / ${totalCycles}`;
    tick();
  }

  startBtn.addEventListener("click", start);
  stopBtn.addEventListener("click", stop);
  cycleBtns.forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => setCycles(Number(b.dataset.cycles))));
})();
</script>
```

## When to use this page

- The hub feels like too much.
- You've been studying for 90+ minutes without a real break.
- You're about to start a mock essay and your hands feel jittery.
- You opened your phone "for one second" 20 minutes ago.

## What this is *not*

Not a substitute for sleep, food, or water. Those win. This is a 90-second pattern interrupt — a way to drop the cortisol baseline before the next study cycle, not a meditation practice.

## After

Go straight to one specific task. Don't look at this site's nav. Don't re-read your plan. The first task on [Tonight's Plan](tonight.html) was correct when you wrote it; do it now.
